item.title: Art Lounge: Collage Night — Thu Aug 13, 7:00 PM
item.description:
Pull up a chair, get a cup of tea, and make something beautiful! Art Lounge is your laid-back Thursday night creative escape — no agenda, no pressure, no experience needed. Just good music, great company, and a table full of materials waiting to become something entirely your own. Cut, tear, layer, and arrange your way through the evening at whatever pace feels right. Not sure where to start? We’ve got prompts to spark your imagination and get the ideas flowing. Or ignore them completely and follow your instincts – either way works perfectly here. Bring your friends, bring your BYOB, and leave with a piece of art you actually made. It’s the best kind of Thursday night. 🗓 Thursday, August 13 | 7:00 pm – 8:30 pm 📍 The Space, 356 Bloomfield Ave, 2nd Floor, Montclair, NJ 🎟 $10 | All materials provided | BYOB welcome Open to everyone. No art experience needed. Just show up and create.
Source: The Space For Art

item.title: UNRECYCLABLE: Look Again - Assemblage Art Exhibit Opening — Fri Aug 14, 5:00 PM
item.description: UNRECYCLABLE: Look Again – Assemblage Art by Andrew Borg Opening Reception: Friday, August 14, 5 – 8pm The Space presents Unrecyclable: Look Again, a solo exhibition of assemblage art by Andrew Borg composed predominantly of the unrecyclable plastics, foams, and composites he refused to throw away for nearly two years — the molded trays, caps, and packaging inserts that carry no recycling code and vanish into the trash without a thought. The exhibition, culminating Borg’s year as Artist in Residence at The Space, is on view August 14–22, 2026, with an opening reception Friday, August 14, from 5 to 8pm. What began as an act of defiance gradually became an act of appreciation: these are highly engineered, purpose-built objects, molded to cushion, position, and protect — aesthetic objects in their own right, designed by someone, meant to be forgotten by everyone. item.title: Tea & Tarot - A Bookclub Style Discussion Group with Gina Devine — Fri Aug 21, 7:00 PM
item.description:
Tea & Tarot: A book club style discussion group with Gina Devine Monthly Gathering | Friday, August 21th | 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM | The Space | $25 Calling all tarot lovers, both new and seasoned! Join us for an intimate way of exploring the cards. What could be better than a cozy evening of warm tea and deep conversation? Join us for Tea & Tarot with Gina Devine—a monthly, book club-style discussion group created to deepen our connection with the archetypes of the tarot through community and shared insight. Rather than a formal class, this is a casual meet-up where we treat the tarot as a living text. Based on the psychological insights of Carl Jung, we will explore the Major Arcana not just as fortune-telling tools, but as mirrors of our own lives, rituals, and transformations. item.title: Inner Body Meditation (20 Minutes) — Sat Aug 22, 10:45 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream "Awareness of the inner body takes you beyond the mind." - Eckhart Tolle
In this mediation session we will bring our attention here: to the inner body. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. They will last around 20 minutes and cameras and microphones will be disabled.
(Depending on the situation, a free discussion may be held at the end with mics and cameras allowed.)
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys also organises a free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group. Visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/) for more information.

item.title: Assemblage Lab & Gallery Talk with Andrew Borg — Sat Aug 22, 1:00 PM
item.description: Assemblage Lab & Gallery Talk with Andrew Borg Closing Event for “Unrecyclable: Look Again” What do you see when you really look at what you throw away? Join artist Andrew Borg for the closing event of Unrecyclable: Look Again — an afternoon that begins with a gallery talk and ends with your hands deep in materials you never thought twice about discarding. After walking through the exhibition and sharing the story behind his two-year collection of unrecyclable plastics, foams, and composites, Borg leads an immersive hands-on Assemblage Lab in which participants get to experience the process firsthand. Using unrecyclable packaging, abandoned electronics, appliances, and other “ghost objects,” you’ll build your own assemblage, sculpture, or mixed-media artwork — guided by the same impulse that drove this exhibition: look again. No artistic experience required. No right or wrong. Just a fresh set of eyes and a willingness to see the overlooked as raw material for something new. Unrec

item.title: Reimagining the Tarot: An Intuitive Collage Workshop — Sun Aug 23, 12:00 PM
item.description:
Reimagining the Tarot: An Intuitive Collage Workshop What if the Tarot could speak in your voice? In this exploratory workshop, we’ll dive into the rich history and symbolism of the Major Arcana — exploring the colors, archetypes, and allegories that have given these iconic cards their power for centuries. Then, we’ll turn that wisdom over to your own creative instincts. No art experience needed. No tarot experience needed. Just an open mind and a willingness to listen to what’s stirring inside you. You’ll choose a card that calls to you, journal your reflections, and then bring it to life through drawing, painting, or collage — reimagining it through your own symbols, style, and personal expression. The goal isn’t perfection; it’s presence. We’re letting intuition lead. 📅 Sunday, August 23 | 12:00 pm – 3:00 pm 📍 The Space, 356 Bloomfield Ave, Loft #2, Montclair, NJ 🎟 $50 | Returning participants: $30 (arrive at 1:30 pm) What You’ll Do:

item.title: Long Pose Figure Drawing and Painting Session — Sun Aug 30, 1:00 PM
item.description: Tuesday Night Sessions: Sunday Edition Sunday, August 30, 1 – 5 pm, $10 per hour or $35 for the full session “The object isn’t to make art, it’s to be in that wonderful state which makes art inevitable.” – Robert Henri This special Sunday session is an extended version of our beloved Tuesday night figure drawing, giving you a full four hours to sink deep into the work. Bring your favorite materials, settle in, listen to some good tunes in great company, and get into your flow. This will be a great opportunity to create a more finished work of art, hone your portraiture skills, or work with a material that you don’t normally get to use. Our model will be dressed in character (more details coming soon) and serve as our muse for the afternoon. Whether you want to loosen up your line work, push into a sustained study, or simply spend a slow Sunday afternoon drawing from life, this is your space to do it. You can stay for the full session, or drop in and pay by the hour for an hour

item.title: Art in Flight: Reinventing Postmodernism with Smithsonian Curator Carolyn Russo — Thu Oct 8, 2:00 PM — Glen Ridge Free Public Library
item.description:
Join us for a captivating online conversation with acclaimed author and Smithsonian curator Carolyn Russo as we dive into her fascinating book, The Ascent of Rauschenberg. Explore the towering legacy, unexpected inspirations, and creative heights of one of America's most influential artistic icons.
Most famous for his groundbreaking "Combines"—painting and sculpture hybrids that often incorporated everyday objects—American artist Robert Rauschenberg (1925-2008) created within a range of mediums, including collage, performance, photography, and printmaking. But a connective tissue through it all was his fascination with flight. The Ascent of Rauschenberg explores the flight motif across his work, spanning birds, insects, aviation, spaceflight, sensory experiences, and metaphors for his own life.
